findings.evidence: The error body uses `"error": "empty_exclude_key" if empty_tokens else "unknown_exclude_key"` and `"keys": empty_tokens or unknown_tokens`, so a request like `?exclude=,nope` reports only the empty token; the caller must fix one class at a time.
findings.title: 400 response reports only one error class when both empty and unknown tokens are present

findings.evidence: When `"graph" not in excluded` is false, the `graph_healthy` evaluation and `graph_stats` fetch still execute above the guarded block; only the slow `collect_graph_inventory` call and the response key are skipped. Consistent with the stated contract (only slow blocks skip computation) but worth know
findings.title: Excluding 'graph' still runs the health probe, only omits the payload key

findings.evidence: Keys such as `version`, `cross_process`, or `model` are fully computed and only removed by the final `metrics.pop` loop; correct per the description, which promises skipped computation only for slow blocks.
findings.title: Fast blocks named in exclude are computed then popped, not skipped

findings.evidence: test_excluding_multiple_slow_blocks_skips_both asserts collect_session_slots/collect_ticket_counts are not awaited, and the session_slots test asserts collect_session_slots.assert_not_awaited(), but no test asserts the graph_inventory slow-block compute lambda is not invoked when graph is excluded —
findings.title: No test pins that ?exclude=graph skips the slow inventory fetch

findings.evidence: EXCLUDABLE_METRICS_KEYS is a frozen literal; a block added to the payload later but not to the set makes ?exclude=<that block> answer 400 while the default payload carries it. Low harm (loud failure, additive-only contract intact, existing consumers unaffected) and already flagged in the test's own
findings.title: Static allowlist can drift from future /metrics payload keys

findings.evidence: The 12-24 KiB pin holds for fixture shapes/volumes built in the test (26 tools, 16 projects, synthetic titles); real production drift (new blocks, longer titles) would not fail CI. Consumer-side enforcement is deferred to red-monitor ticket 79a36d3e per the description.
findings.title: Size budget is enforced only against the synthetic fixture

findings.evidence: test_excluded_block_status_is_not_published repeats the second half of test_block_status_is_kept_when_slow_block_is_excluded (same request, same assertion) verbatim; one of the two is redundant.
findings.title: Duplicate coverage for excluding block_status
